|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Cancel a Force drain at a holosite. OR If opponent is about to place your character out of play, place that character in your Lost Pile instead. OR ▲any dejarik, hologram, or any holosite.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Escape Pod (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Take a dejarik, hologram, or holosite into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain at a holosite. OR If opponent is about to place your character out of play, place that character in your Lost Pile instead.” '''What changed:''' added “Take a dejarik, hologram, or holosite into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR”; removed “OR ▲any dejarik, hologram, or any holosite.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 1, slip 6. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Escape Pod]].
* Later text: [[Escape Pod (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
